label: Chat Message
description: Append one message to a conversation kept in a file (`historyFile`), in place: the same file an LLM node reads and adds its turns to, so a conversation is built by chaining this node and the AI calls on one file. With no file in, the message starts a new conversation file, kept past the run. Media attachments ride inside messages as stored files. Role 'tool' feeds a tool call's result back: in an agent's tool loop, set `role: "tool"`, wire the tool's result to `text`, the call's `id` to `toolCallId` and the loop's carried file to `historyFile`; this node's `historyFile` output is the loop's next carry.

inputs.name: historyFile
inputs.description: The conversation so far, kept in a stored file (an LLM node's or another Chat Message's `historyFile` output, or a file holding `[]`). The message is added to this same file, in place. Unwired, the message starts a new conversation file.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this message: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolCallId
inputs.description: For role 'tool' only: the id of the tool call this message answers (from an LLM node's toolCalls output).

inputs.name: cacheBreakpoint
inputs.label: Cache up to here
inputs.description: Mark this message as a prompt-cache breakpoint: everything up to and including it is cached by providers that support it, and the next call reuses it. Put the stable part of a conversation (persona, reference material) before the mark and the volatile part after. A conversation carrying any mark of its own turns the LLM node's automatic marks off.

outputs.name: historyFile
outputs.description: The conversation including this message: the file that came in (next version), or the new one this message started. Wire it into the next node's `historyFile`.
